name: Bamboo Plot Tokenization
description: Real-world-asset tokenization of sustainable bamboo cultivation plots (ERC-20) where the total token supply for a plot represents 100% fractional ownership of that plot's yield rights — investors buy tokens for any fraction of a registered plot. Minting registers a new plot's shares against a verified land/cultivation record (gated behind maker-checker approval, since it asserts both land rights and a carbon claim). Transfers double as the on-chain chain-of-custody record as physical custody of the harvested bamboo passes from grower to processor to distributor to retailer — the current token holder is the current custodian, timestamped and anchored by the platform's existing audit trail. Burning retires a plot's shares (e.g. on full buyout or end-of-life). Freeze places a compliance hold on an account.

plotId.description: Registry identifier for the specific bamboo plot/parcel — enforced unique so one plot is tokenized only once

species.description: Bamboo species cultivated, e.g. Bambusa balcooa, Dendrocalamus strictus

cooperativeOrGrower.description: Cultivating entity — cooperative, farmer collective, or individual grower

totalShares.description: Total token supply that represents 100% fractional ownership of this plot — a holder's fraction of the plot is their balance divided by this figure

cultivationStartDate.description: Date cultivation began on this plot (YYYY-MM-DD)

certificationBody.description: Sustainable-cultivation certification authority, e.g. FSC, organic certifier

certificateUrl.description: Off-ledger link to the cultivation/sustainability certificate (only its hash lives on-ledger)

certificateHash.description: SHA-256 of the certificate (pins the off-ledger document as proof of origin)

co2SequesteredTonsPerYear.description: Verified or estimated CO2e sequestered by this plot per year (tonnes)

carbonMethodology.description: Carbon-accounting methodology applied, e.g. a Verra AR/ALM methodology reference

carbonVerifier.description: Third party that verified the carbon sequestration claim

linkedCarbonCreditAssetId.description: Asset id of the carbon-credit (VCU) instrument separately minted against this plot's verified sequestration, if any — the plot token and its carbon credits are independently tradable, this field only records the link
